title: NEW MSFS Marketplace drop: Concorde bundles, 46 hard landings & summer routes!
description:
In this video, we’re breaking down the latest marketplace releases so you can skip the long store page menu guessing and know exactly what you are flying next.

The marketplace just received a fresh wave of activity packs, massive master collection bundles, and operational schedule add-ons for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. Whether you want to command scheduled Airbus A320 operations, test your crosswind technique across 46 rigorous landing challenges, push Mach 2 in the iconic Concorde, or inject authentic real-world summer timetables into major global hubs, this drop brings serious replay value to your simulator. We divide the breakdown into three distinct categories:

✈️ Flagship Collections & Commercial Operations: We explore high-value multi-packs and commemorative drops, starting with the Advanced Landings Master Collection #7 featuring 46 unique landing tests across Spain, Mexico, Brazil, and Guyana. We also look at Perfect Flight's Concorde Master Collection (bundling the Adventure Concorde and Advanced Landing Challenges—note: requires the DC Designs Concorde), plus the America 250 American Airlines release for the iniBuilds A320neo V2 featuring custom liveries, 12 IFR missions, authentic sounds, and a dedicated mini-browser.

📅 Global Airline Fleet Schedules (Summer Overhaul by VA Systems): A comprehensive look at summer schedule timetable expansions across five major carriers: Air Niugini, Gulf Air, Sun Country Airlines, Scoot, and Vueling. We review the authentic real-world summer route networks and liveries, alongside important buyer reminders regarding base aircraft dependencies.

🌍 International Hub Traffic Overhauls (by VA Systems): Real-world timetable and livery injections designed to populate airport gates with authentic airline operations. This week's featured international hubs include Montreal Trudeau (CYUL), Copenhagen (EKCH), Wellington (NZWN), Bahrain (OBBI), and Beijing Daxing (ZBAD).

Whether you're breaking the sound barrier in Concorde, mastering crosswind arrivals in Latin America and Europe, or loading summer airline traffic into Beijing Daxing and Copenhagen, this marketplace drop has plenty of flying to keep your logbook full.

Drop a comment below and let me know: Which of these routes, bundles, or landing challenges are you flying first? Make sure to hit the like button, subscribe to High in the Flightsim Sky for weekly flight simulator updates, and clear skies on your next flight!
